public_contract: from shipping import shipping_fee; shipping_fee(total_cents: int) -> int. For integer total_cents >= 0 and < 10000 return 500; for >=10000 return 0; for negative integers raise ValueError. Noninteger inputs are outside scope.
future_test_files: Test author chooses one new file per current example; author only current example.
dependencies: Python standard library unittest; tests only, no fixtures/helpers/config beyond files in tests; no third-party packages.
requirement_basis: README.md sole behavior authority; no production observations used. Existing public CURRENCY remains USD.
observation_seam: Direct public Python function call and returned integer or ValueError; no mocks, private helpers, internal ordering, error-message requirements, or new dependencies.

prerequisites: fee-at-10000 closed with current Green and affected regressions
fee-at-9999 closed with current Green and affected regressions

authoring_constraint: Exactly one main new independent behavior test per example, serial order 10000, 9999, -1. Refine/pin current contract immediately before its authoring; do not preauthor later examples.

provenance.sanitization: No production source, diffs, private logs, or implementation-notes read or included.
